title: Integrative machine learning-guided in silico and in vitro approach reveals selective small molecule inhibitors targeting mutant IDH1
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,50944-50962
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06290J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mayank Bajaj, Rohit Kumar, Vishal Pandey, Shahnawaz Parvez, Hemanth Kumar Tanneru, Polamarasetty Aparoy, Roy Karnati
The study developed machine learning models to predict the key hotspots within the allosteric inhibitor binding site of mutant Isocitrate Dehydrogenase 1 (IDH1) enzyme and validated the inhibition by in silico and in vitro screening.
